claims.entity: Amazon Web Services, free data transfer out when moving off AWS
claims.metric: egress charge under the leaving program, on request and approval
claims.unit: USD per GB, credited after approval
claims.boundary: Data transfer out to the internet when an eligible customer moves all of its data off AWS, or all of its data off one service. A credit on request, not a list price. Eligible customers outside the EU have 180 days, as of the page's 10/08/2026 update.

source.title: Free data transfer out to internet when moving out of AWS

claims.quote: AWS offers eligible customers free data transfer out to the internet when they move all of their data off of AWS from all Eligible Accounts or all of their data off of a particular AWS service across their Eligible Accounts

claims.entity: Google Cloud, free data transfer when exiting
claims.metric: egress charge under the exit program, on request
claims.unit: USD per GB, on an approved Exit Notice
claims.boundary: A customer migrating all of its workloads and data from the relevant Google Cloud service to another provider or an on-premises data center, after submitting an Exit Notice.

source.title: Applying for free data transfer when exiting Google Cloud

claims.quote: you are eligible for free data transfer when you migrate all of your workloads and data from the relevant Google Cloud service to another cloud provider or an on-premises data center.

claims.entity: UK Competition and Markets Authority, free switching programmes at AWS, Google, and Microsoft
claims.metric: conditions on free egress when leaving a cloud
claims.boundary: A regulator's reading of three programs as they stood in its 2024 and 2025 evidence: leaving all data or one whole service, pre-approval, deleting what remains or closing the account, a time limit, and the vendor's right to change the program.

source.title: Appendix N: Egress fees, free switching programmes (final decision)

claims.quote: on 13 March 2024, Microsoft announced that it also offers free egress globally for customers leaving Azure when taking their data out of the Azure infrastructure via the internet to switch to another cloud provider or an on-premises.
claims.limit: A UK regulator's reading dated 07/31/2025, in its final decision; the provisional appendix of 01/28/2025 is replaced. Outside the EU, AWS's blog update of 10/08/2026 (mv-001) gives 180 days to complete a move, where this appendix recorded 60 days for AWS (paragraph N.24(b)), so check each program's current terms.

claims.entity: Office of Management and Budget, M-25-27, status of a federal social cost of greenhouse gases
claims.metric: federal policy on a uniform monetized estimate of greenhouse gas impacts
claims.boundary: The federal position as of the memorandum's date, 05/05/2025. It speaks for the federal government, not for any state or Nation.

source.title: M-25-27, Guidance Implementing Section 6 of Executive Order 14154, Entitled "Unleashing American Energy"
source.publisher: Office of Management and Budget, Executive Office of the President

claims.quote: As such, it is no longer Federal government policy to maintain a uniform estimate of the monetized impacts of greenhouse gas emissions.
